instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-16: 比較じゃないのに？ / もろもろ修正内容を出せ / 直せ
instruction: Fix the existing Sellemy discovery-first product workflow without changing the 3 grouped angles x 2 products format. Bound continuous planning to at most 2 rounds for direct calls and one topic per scheduled create role; reduce repeated identical Amazon queries per axis to 2 attempts. Persist attempted topics before external calls and skip those already attempted in past 24h. Product QA and Writer must not send accepted products back to PRODUCT_HOLD merely because comparative superiority or optional differences lack proof. Product return to QA requires an actual unrelated/duplicate item. Recover one existing PRODUCT_HOLD with six verified item excerpts per normal non-scheduled cycle, using a fresh independent semantic acceptance when the old one is stale; preserve evidence and already-passed stages. Keep holds with missing verified facts held for sourcing. Preserve all independent QA/CEO approval and publication gates; do not retroactively modify published articles.
preserved_rules: 3 discovery angle groups x 2 products and six distinct verified product identities
Original independent review and QA certification remain required
All product facts must be attributable to verified evidence
Only confirmed off-topic or proved duplicates permit product reselection
Preserve previously approved and published article content
One new creation attempt per scheduled slot and durable local attempt record
No repeated bulk revalidation; one existing six-sourced product hold per nonscheduled cycle
